service: sms-backend

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ap-south-1
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'prod'}
  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - https://training2expert.vercel.app
        - https://www.training2expert.com
        - http://localhost:3000
      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
        - X-Amz-Date
        - X-Api-Key
        - X-Amz-Security-Token
      allowedMethods:
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - PATCH
        - DELETE
        - OPTIONS
      allowCredentials: true
  memorySize: 512
  timeout: 29
  architecture: arm64
  environment:
    NODE_ENV: production
    DATABASE_URL: ${env:DATABASE_URL}
    JWT_SECRET: ${env:JWT_SECRET}
    JWT_EXPIRES_IN: ${env:JWT_EXPIRES_IN, '30d'}
    CORS_ORIGIN: ${env:CORS_ORIGIN, '*'}
    FRONTEND_URL: ${env:FRONTEND_URL, ''}
    S3_BUCKET: ${env:S3_BUCKET}
    S3_SIGNED_URL_EXPIRY_SECONDS: ${env:S3_SIGNED_URL_EXPIRY_SECONDS, '300'}
    SES_FROM_EMAIL: ${env:SES_FROM_EMAIL, ''}
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:DeleteObject
          Resource: arn:aws:s3:::${env:S3_BUCKET}/*
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - ses:SendEmail
            - ses:SendRawEmail
          Resource: '*'

package:
  individually: true
  patterns:
    - '!**'

functions:
  api:
    handler: dist/lambda.handler
    description: SMS Backend API
    package:
      patterns:
        - dist/lambda.mjs
        - dist/lambda.mjs.map
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /{proxy+}
          method: ANY
      - httpApi:
          path: /
          method: ANY
    provisionedConcurrency: ${env:PROVISIONED_CONCURRENCY, null}

  cron:
    handler: dist/cron.deactivateInactiveRecruiters
    description: Daily recruiter deactivation
    memorySize: 256
    timeout: 60
    package:
      patterns:
        - dist/cron.mjs
        - dist/cron.mjs.map
    events:
      - schedule:
          rate: cron(30 1 * * ? *)
          enabled: true
